clips.title: The story
paras: Journey to Astranaar is an introductory Alliance quest guiding newcomers arriving on the Kalimdor coast to the inland heart of Ashenvale. Directed by Fiora Longears at Theramore, travelers make their way north toward Ashenvale to report to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar. It marks an adventurer's entry into the growing conflicts surrounding the night elves' ancestral forest.

Alliance travelers arriving in Dustwallow Marsh aboard the ferry from Menethil Harbor often look for purpose in northern Kalimdor. At Theramore, Fiora Longears directs capable hands to move deeper inland toward Astranaar, the main night elven settlement within Ashenvale. The journey follows winding paths under ancient, shadowed canopies, leading straight into a forest strained by war and unrest.

Curiously, Fiora tells travelers not to bother mentioning her name when arriving in Astranaar, stating plainly that Shindrell Swiftfire does not know her. Her role is simply to funnel fresh Alliance talent where it is needed most. Upon arriving, Shindrell readily welcomes any able-bodied defender, acknowledging that while Ashenvale remains breathtaking, it is no longer the peaceful sanctuary it once was.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... Go to Astranaar. I'm sure an eager member of the Alliance such as you can do some real good there. Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.
But don't bother mentioning who sent you. Shindrell does not know me...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here to offer your services to the Alliance, friend? We welcome the aid, for although its beauty remains... Ashenvale Forest is not the peaceful place it once was.
